official_sources.title: GDALRasterBand ComputeRasterMinMax exact mode
official_sources.finding: ComputeRasterMinMax with approximate=false reads all pixels for an exact range and excludes nodata.

official_sources.title: GDALRasterBand ComputeRasterMinMaxLocation tie behavior
official_sources.finding: Min/max location ignores nodata/masked pixels, but when the same extremum occurs at multiple cells GDAL does not specify which location is returned.

official_sources.title: GDALRasterBand ComputeStatistics exact versus approximate
official_sources.finding: Approximate statistics may use overviews or a subset of tiles; exact terminal extrema therefore require explicit all-pixel computation.

official_sources.title: GDALRasterBand cached statistics
official_sources.finding: Statistics can be cached in PAM/metadata and ClearStatistics exists; cached values are not treated as a fresh terminal scan.

official_sources.title: gdal raster info exact min-max
official_sources.finding: --min-max forces actual min/max computation; --stats uses all pixels while --approx-stats may use a subset.

official_sources.title: gdal raster info checksum
official_sources.finding: Raster info can compute a band checksum, but checksum is a separate diagnostic from actual min/max and pixel equivalence.

official_sources.title: GDALChecksumImage 16-bit semantics
official_sources.finding: Checksum is only 16-bit (0-65535), so equality of checksums cannot prove equality of elevation rasters.

official_sources.title: GDALChecksumImage float truncation semantics
official_sources.finding: Floating-point data are converted to 32-bit integer for checksum, so decimal portions do not affect the checksum.

official_sources.title: Java Band checksum confirmation
official_sources.finding: Java binding confirms 16-bit checksum and loss of floating decimal portions, reinforcing checksum-as-diagnostic-only policy.

official_sources.title: gdal raster compare golden dataset
official_sources.finding: Raster compare checks pixel content plus dimensions, band datatype/nodata and optional CRS/geotransform/metadata against a golden reference.

official_sources.title: gdal raster compare skip controls
official_sources.finding: Skipping CRS, geotransform, metadata or other comparisons weakens equivalence and is rejected for terminal replay.

official_sources.title: gdalcompare legacy independent comparison
official_sources.finding: Legacy gdalcompare also reports pixel and metadata differences and can independently corroborate golden visible-data equality.

official_sources.title: gdal raster pixel-info address replay
official_sources.finding: Pixel-info reports input coordinates converted to column/line plus raw and unscaled values for selected cells.

official_sources.title: gdal raster pixel-info VRT contributor
official_sources.finding: For VRT, pixel-info can report contributing source file(s), enabling independent extrema-source replay.

official_sources.title: gdal raster as-features row-column audit
official_sources.finding: as-features can emit ROW/COL and CENTER_X/CENTER_Y for every pixel and skip nodata, supporting independent tie-set address audit.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster data model pixel center
official_sources.finding: Raster size, geotransform and coordinate system are dataset properties that must remain bound to every extrema cell identity.

official_sources.title: RFC 15 mask validity
official_sources.finding: Band masks use zero for invalid and nonzero for valid; masked extrema must be excluded before comparison.

official_sources.title: RFC 58 nodata mutability
official_sources.finding: NoData can be removed or represented through driver/PAM mechanisms, so validity provenance must be pinned rather than inferred from a numeric sentinel alone.

official_sources.title: gdal raster calc spatial checks
official_sources.finding: Raster calc has explicit CRS/extent consistency checks and configurable nodata propagation; disabling them can make spatially invalid arithmetic look plausible.

official_sources.title: gdal_calc datatype arithmetic caveat
official_sources.finding: Intermediate arithmetic can retain operand datatype and produce unexpected results; terminal subtraction therefore replays full-precision operands explicitly.

official_sources.title: gdal raster set-type datatype forcing
official_sources.finding: set-type forces a requested output datatype; terminal extrema provenance rejects narrowing conversions unless exact preservation is independently proven.

official_sources.title: RFC 100 Float16 support
official_sources.finding: Float16 is a 16-bit floating type; lower precision storage is not promoted as terminal accuracy without source-proof.

official_sources.title: gdal_translate strict data preservation
official_sources.finding: Strict mode can fail operations that may lose information, including datatype conversions that cannot be preserved exactly.

official_sources.title: gdal raster unscale formula
official_sources.finding: Unscaled value equals raw*scale+offset; raw and decoded extrema comparisons must not be conflated.

official_sources.title: gdal raster convert derivative identity
official_sources.finding: Format conversion creates a new dataset; converted artifacts require pixel and spatial-metadata equivalence before terminal use.

official_sources.title: GTiff masks and overview sidecars
official_sources.finding: GeoTIFF overviews and nodata masks may be internal or external; full file/mask state belongs in immutable extrema provenance.

official_sources.title: gdal raster reproject approximation
official_sources.finding: Reprojection may use a permitted transformation approximation and resampling, so reprojected extrema are not native-cell terminal extrema.

official_sources.title: gdal raster mosaic resolution policy
official_sources.finding: Mosaic resolution and target alignment are configurable; terminal tie-set replay pins the native source grid instead of derived mosaic choices.

official_sources.title: gdalbuildvrt overlap and resampling
official_sources.finding: VRT construction can alter overlap priority, resolution, extent, resampling and nodata semantics; these choices must be frozen for replay.

official_sources.title: gdal raster fill-nodata synthetic values
official_sources.finding: Fill-nodata interpolates values from neighbors and can create values absent from the native raster; such values are excluded from terminal extrema.

official_sources.title: GDALRasterBand native block access
official_sources.finding: Native block access and actual edge block size permit a deterministic full-resolution scan without undefined padding.

official_sources.title: gdal raster info approximate-stat warning
official_sources.finding: GDAL documents approximate statistics as useful when precise stats are not needed; terminal elevation extrema therefore reject approximate-stat evidence.
